text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOH, unpolished and unfinished as it 
may be, this is for all the ones who 
couldn't make it here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll carve these footprints in! 
Uoryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket brilliantly slashes past 
all her rivals!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"This is no modern, lightweight run! With 
a turf-crushing, powerhouse performance, 
she has snatched the first crown!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHT!! How's that, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I totally owned the race that Fuji-san 
couldn't run in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bursting with joy, they shared the moment. 
Jungle Pocket had overcome her weakness on 
right-handed tracks through sheer spirit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, to have reached this point already at 
this stage...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing short of pure delight. Still, 
well... it isn't quite fun, is it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, there's something I need to tell 
you. Today, not yet—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The beginning—what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to deciding who stands at 
the top—the leader of our generation— it's 
undeniably the next race, the Nippon 
Derby."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you at the very pinnacle! Only 
by doing that can I be the strongest of 
our generation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I see. Well, that makes sense. I 
want that too, after all. To beat you in 
the Derby. Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Being defeated, that is.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Beaten?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However, light converges where it 
ought to converge. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the end of a beginning, and the start 
of the next. See you, Pokke-kun.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't get this at all... Hey, Tachyon! 
You'd better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll damn well show 'em at the Japanese 
Derby. The roar of the demon, my most 
terrifying run!"
